messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: plotting sampler parameters
parts:
What would be the most helpful visuals to have with regard to the nuts sampler parameters?

I was thinking maybe a plot of iteration vs value for accept_stat, treedepth and n_leapfrog, and a rug plot for n_divergent.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] plotting sampler parameters
parts:
There's also stepsize, but that only changes after adaptation
if the stepsize jitter parameter's set, which we don't usually
recommend.

So plot vs. iteration is just like a traceplot, right? Treating
them like parameters makes sense to me.

The types matter:

* accept_stat is continuous
* treedepth is an integer
* n_divergent is binary (at least for NUTS and HMC)

Ideally, we'd use bar plots rather than histograms for discrete
quantities. We can have discrete "parameters" produced as generated
quantities. Right now, our print and plotting doesn't really do right
by these.

I'm not so keen on rug plots if that's the thing that prints the
observations on the horizontal axis as ticks and then plots
a density estimate above it. And it won't work for n_divergent, because
it's a binary quantity.

- Bob

> On Mar 9, 2015, at 11:35 AM, Jonah <jga...@gmail.com> wrote:

>
> I was thinking maybe a plot of iteration vs value for accept_stat, treedepth and n_leapfrog, and a rug plot for n_divergent.
>

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] plotting sampler parameters
parts:
What you want is

(a) Average accept stat
(b) Histogram of treedepth (to check whether it’s saturating against max_depth)
(c) Number of iterations with n_divergent != 0.

Distributions of accept_stat (vs parameter values) can be sort of useful in some cases
but it’s hard to disentangle the meaning without really knowing the sampler. Plotting it
vs iteration is just a bad proxy for plotting vs parameter value so I wouldn’t recommend it.

On Mar 9, 2015, at 12:35 AM, Jonah <jga...@gmail.com> wrote:

> What would be the most helpful visuals to have with regard to the nuts sampler parameters?

> I was thinking maybe a plot of iteration vs value for accept_stat, treedepth and n_leapfrog, and a rug plot for n_divergent.
